test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What is the name of the programme launched by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology in 2021 to assist startups in their early stages?
solution:
The correct answer is __**SAMRIDH**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Union government has launched a program to support 300__ IT start-ups.
 
• The government would provide seed funding and market access with a view to creating 100 unicorns out of the selected start-ups.
 
• The concept of the Startup Accelerator of MeitY for Product Innovation, Development & Growth (SAMRIDH) has been developed on the lines of silicon valley based accelerator YCombinator.</l
